record_type_quote: In the present study, we ran a replication of the experiment by Giesen et al. (2017) who found reversed observationally acquired stimulus-response binding and retrieval (oSRBR) effects after negative feedback and standard oSRBR effects after positive feedback.

targets.authors: Giesen, C., Scherdin, K., & Rothermund, K.
targets.title: Flexible goal imitation: Vicarious feedback influences stimulus-response binding by observation.
targets.evidence_quote: In the present study, we ran a replication of the experiment by Giesen et al. (2017) who found reversed observationally acquired stimulus-response binding and retrieval (oSRBR) effects after negative feedback and standard oSRBR effects after positive feedback.
targets.outcome_quote: We could not replicate the findings of Giesen et al. ( 2017 ), as oSRBR effects were not reversed after negative feedback.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict in Conclusion governs; minor limitations do not override it. Additional experiment reportedly mirrors the failure.
